REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JANUARY 13, 2022 - 07:00 P.M.
ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS LINK: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89729537465
MEETING ID # 897 2953 7465
*THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER IS CLOSED FOR THIS MEETING. THE MEETING WILL BE CONDUCTED VIA TELECONFERENCE ONLY* INSTRUCTIONS FOR PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN THIS MEETING ARE LISTED BELOW
* COVID-19 NOTICE *
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, and in compliance with the current State Department of Public Health and Los Angeles County Health Officer Orders and City of Cerritos COVID-19 Safety Plan, the City Council Chamber will be closed to the public for this meeting. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20, N-29-20, N-08-21, and subsequently by Assembly Bill 361 (Chapter 165, Statutes of 2021), this meeting will be conducted via teleconference only. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after the distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or by connecting to the ZOOM meeting described below.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using any of the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: Live audio public comments can be made by connecting to the meeting using the information listed below. Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time during the meeting agenda and must be available at the time they are called upon to speak.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89729537465
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 897 2953 7465
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended.   Closed Session Report

  Bill Ihrke, City Attorney, reported the City Council convened into Closed Session to discuss
  Item 12D on the Closed Session agenda. Items 12A, 12B, and 12C were not discussed.

  With regard to Item 12D, the following reportable action was taken:

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to seek appellate review,
  as a co-appellant, of an appealable order and judgment filed in Los Angeles County
  Superior Court case no. 21 STCP01970, case name Orange County Council of Governments,
  et al. v. Velasquez, as Interim Director for the California Department of Housing and
  Community Development (or HCD), with Real Party in Interest Southern California
  Association of Governments (SCAG).

  In summary, the petition for writ of mandate in this case sought to set aside the Regional
  Housing Needs Assessment (or “RHNA”) allocation of 1,341,827 dwelling units as
  determined by HCD for the SCAG region, change input data, and re-calculate the SCAG
  regional housing need. The trial court sustained demurrers filed by HCD and SCAG, which
  argued that judicial review is not available under the RHNA process. Sustaining the
  demurrers effectively dismissed the petition, and judgment was entered in favor of HCD
  and SCAG, and against the petitioners, on December 21, 2021.

  By the action approved by the City Council tonight, Cerritos will continue to be a co-party
  to the lawsuit and has authorized an appeal for review of the trial court’s decision and
  judgment (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
